killedBy: pinnedSeedUrl recreates the seed without touching anything REPLACES a seed the URL already carried rather than appending a second
why: Appends the pinned seed instead of replacing one the URL already carried. `devflags.ts` reads a duplicated parameter's FIRST value -- `canonicalDevSearch`'s own comment says so, and says why canonicalising to the last would be wrong -- so the URL then reproduces the OLD seed while displaying the new one. Silent, and silent in the worst direction: the developer reloads, sees a different world, and concludes the seed does not work. The killing test PARSES the result with the same `parseDevFlags` the game boots with rather than string-matching, which is the only assertion that can tell the two apart.
